cases.description: Create a valid ARCHITECTURE.md from sufficient upstream system, foundation, and repository evidence.
expected: Answers the primary structural question
Defines structural units, boundaries, and dependency direction
Respects ownership boundaries with SYSTEM.md and DECISIONS.md
Passes specification acceptance criteria

cases.description: System boundaries are incomplete or conflicting across documents and repository evidence.
expected: Does not invent a resolved architecture
Labels assumptions and contradictions
Reports blocked or provisional completion
Requests the missing upstream clarification

cases.description: An existing ARCHITECTURE.md must be updated after a structural refactor while preserving still-valid sections.
expected: Updates only the affected structural model
Retains valid existing intent where supported
Revalidates dependency direction and constraints
Reports downstream documents needing review

cases.description: Input material turns ARCHITECTURE.md into a deployment guide, ADR log, or source tree walkthrough.
expected: Identifies the boundary violation
Keeps non-architectural detail out of the canonical document
Explains the correct owning artifact
Produces a safe structural-focused revision or follow-up

cases.description: The real task is to decide what systems exist before any structural organization can be justified.
expected: Declines to use this skill as the primary tool
Directs the work toward SYSTEM.md authoring first
Avoids fabricating structure without a system model
Explains why the trigger is negative
